title: Gentle Cowork Blackboard Dashboard
brief: TUI dashboard for monitoring blackboard state: contracts, leases, fences, and budget usage in real-time

artboards.title: Main Dashboard - Full Layout (180x50)
artboards.tradeoff: Dense information layout with all sections visible; trades some visual breathing room for maximum data density

artboards.title: Narrow View - Compact Layout (80x24)
artboards.tradeoff: Compact layout for small terminals; stacks sections vertically, reduces horizontal density but keeps all critical data visible

artboards.title: Alert View - Critical Issues Focus (180x50)
artboards.tradeoff: Alert-focused layout highlighting critical issues (expiring leases, budget thresholds, failed contracts); trades general overview for actionable urgency
